claim_provenance.claim: Chartbeat aggregate data sourced for the report show Google organic-search traffic to more than 2,500 sites fell 33% globally between November 2024 and November 2025.
For Q5, the average slider score among 268 respondents was −43%, indicating an expectation of declining search-engine traffic over the next three years, not an observed change.

Among 264 Q13 respondents, the reported net difference between proportions saying an area was more versus less important for newsroom focus in the era of AI was +91 points for original investigations/on-the-ground reporting, +82 for contextual analysis (explanation, framing), and −42 for service journalism; these are stated perceptions, not evidence of changed newsroom behavior.

For planning, MarketLense recommends keeping observed search traffic, respondents’ search expectations, and stated content priorities as separate inputs rather than treating stated priorities as evidence that newsroom practice has shifted.
